fields.summary_ko.0: Nvidia (NVDA) exceeded expectations with adjusted Q3 EPS of $2.68 (vs. $2.47 expected) and Q4 revenue guidance of $127.4–$132.6B, but the stock fell approximately 3.5% due to leadership change involving founder Jensen Huang.
fields.summary_ko.1: NVDA raised its fiscal 2028 revenue growth guidance from 70% to 75%, but the leadership transition has had a negative impact on investor sentiment.
